package_title: Dated backfill: food-access pressure reports from October 13–17, 2026
retrospective_notice: These reports retain their October 13, October 15, and October 17 publication dates. They describe dated developments and are not new October 20 events.

items.headline: Minnesota food shelves struggle to keep pace with rising visits
items.summary: MPR News reported October 17 that Minnesota food shelves faced accelerating visits and extended hours without keeping pace with demand; Second Harvest Heartland said rising freight costs led it to trim other spending and reduce some produce purchases.

items.headline: Golden Harvest faces increased need as donated and federal food declines
items.summary: WRDW/WAGT reported October 15 that Golden Harvest served 24 counties in Georgia and South Carolina amid increased need, empty warehouses, and reduced donated and federal commodity food.

items.headline: Food pantries report rising visits and shrinking reserves
items.summary: PBS NewsHour reported October 13 that FeedMore saw visits rise 20% over the preceding year, while Moments of Hope saw visits double over two years and reserves fall from about two months at the start of the year to two weeks.
